name: Kraken

mechanics.name: Whirlpools
mechanics.description: The Kraken is asleep until you wake it. Disturbing the four small whirlpools each pulls up an enormous tentacle, and only then does the large whirlpool respond.
mechanics.counterplay: Use a fishing explosive on the large whirlpool to skip the tentacles and pull the Kraken straight out.

mechanics.name: Standard Attack
mechanics.description: Its only attack is a typeless magical ranged hit that lands its damage the moment it fires, before the projectile reaches you. Protection prayers do nothing against it.
mechanics.counterplay: Wear magic defence gear, since that is what its accuracy rolls against. No overhead helps, so stay above 45 hitpoints.

mechanics.name: Enormous Tentacles
mechanics.description: Four tentacles sit alongside the Kraken for the whole fight. They hit for almost nothing but they never stop, and they carry no slayer credit.
mechanics.counterplay: Ignore them and tank the chip damage. Killing them wastes time you could spend on the Kraken.

_note: SKELETON, NOT LIVE-VERIFIED. Ids come from Jagex's own gameval names rather than guesses, but nothing here has been confirmed in a live fight. Provenance: gamevals from runelite-api 1.12.35 (net.runelite.api.gameval.*), because this cache download ships an empty GAMEVALS index (idx24) and ScanGameVal cannot read it; npc names, models, sequences and extents from the live cache (revision of 2026-08-06). Jagex's internal name for this boss is SLAYER_KRAKEN_BOSS 494; SLAYER_KRAKEN 492 and SLAYER_KRAKEN_SUB 493 are the ordinary cave kraken and its whirlpool, and KRAKEN_PET 6640 (with 6656) is the pet, so none of the four is in npcIds. The whirlpools and the tentacle are npcs in their own right, which is what gives this boss its first and third mechanics an honest trigger: SLAYER_KRAKEN_BOSS_WHIRLPOOL 496 is the large one, SLAYER_KRAKEN_BOSS_TENTACLE_WHIRLPOOL 5534 the small ones and SLAYER_KRAKEN_BOSS_TENTACLE 5535 the enormous tentacle. All four are adds and detect on npc-spawn rather than sitting in npcIds. THIS BOSS SHARES ITS ANIMATION SET WITH AN UNRELATED NPC. Npc 494's standing animation is 3989, which the gamevals name SWAN_QUEEN_READY, so the whole Kraken animation set is the Swan Song quest boss's set reused. SWAN_QUEEN_SPELLCAST 3992 is curated as its attack on that basis, over SWAN_QUEEN_ATTACK 3991, because the wiki describes a single magical ranged attack and 3992 is the casting sequence. That is an inference from a reused animation name rather than an attested mapping and is the weakest link in this file. The tentacle likewise reuses ABYSSAL_TENTACLE_SLEEPING 3617 as its standing animation. No projectile is curated: the cache names no KRAKEN spotanim at all, so there is nothing with an unambiguous _PROJ name to add, and guessing at an id would risk a false discovery that never revokes (docs/DECISIONS.md D17, D18). THIS IS A THIN BOSS AND THREE MECHANICS IS AN HONEST COUNT, not a shortfall: the wiki's whole strategy page amounts to one attack, four tentacles and a way to skip the opening. Zoom and shiftY are FitZoom output at the shipped 291x140 box plus the standard 10% margin. The whirlpool's shiftY of 6 is correct and not a mistake: it is a flat model lying on the ground plane, so it needs almost no vertical correction, unlike every other preview in this wave. staticFallback is false on all three; whether each body animation reads has not been eyeballed in game. The collection log page is titled 'Kraken', matching 'name'. FEEDBACK PASS 2026-08-07 (Andrew reviewed every boss in game): Two renames: "Disturbed Whirlpools" is now "Whirlpools" and "Typeless Barrage" is now "Standard Attack". PREVIEW PASS 2026-08-07: The whirlpool is rotated a half turn (rotationY 1024) so it presents its front.
